title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - GeographicLocation
description: A GeographicLocation is a pure-virtual super-class to the GeoJSON-aligned geometries of Point (addresses and locations), MultiPoint, LineString (streets, highways and boundaries), MultiLineString and Polygon (countries, provinces, tracts of land). Use the @type attribute to specify which of these is being specified by the geometry attribute. (TM Forum TMF675 API GeographicLocation 4.0.0, Swagger definition GeographicLocation; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:GeographicLocation:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'GeographicLocation'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF675_GeographicLocation/blob/fed0239d350d8080e0e9dfe8e488b01981d151f9/TMF675-GeographicLocation-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/GeographicLocation/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:GeographicLocation:<tmfId>. Unique identifier of the geographic location

href.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF675_GeographicLocation/blob/fed0239d350d8080e0e9dfe8e488b01981d151f9/TMF675-GeographicLocation-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/GeographicLocation/properties/href'. An URI used to access to the geographic location resource

name.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF675_GeographicLocation/blob/fed0239d350d8080e0e9dfe8e488b01981d151f9/TMF675-GeographicLocation-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Place/properties/name'. A user-friendly name for the place, such as [Paris Store], [London Store], [Main Home]

tmfBaseType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF675_GeographicLocation/blob/fed0239d350d8080e0e9dfe8e488b01981d151f9/TMF675-GeographicLocation-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Place/properties/@baseType'. Renamed from TMF '@baseType' (JSON-LD keyword). When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

tmfSchemaLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF675_GeographicLocation/blob/fed0239d350d8080e0e9dfe8e488b01981d151f9/TMF675-GeographicLocation-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Place/properties/@schemaLocation'. Renamed from TMF '@schemaLocation' (JSON-LD keyword). A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

tmfType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF675_GeographicLocation/blob/fed0239d350d8080e0e9dfe8e488b01981d151f9/TMF675-GeographicLocation-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/GeographicLocation/properties/@type'. Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'GeographicLocation' or a sub-class / extension name. The name of the GeoJSON structure used in the geometry attribute

bbox.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF675_GeographicLocation/blob/fed0239d350d8080e0e9dfe8e488b01981d151f9/TMF675-GeographicLocation-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/GeographicLocation/properties/bbox'. A bounding box array that contains the geometry. The axes order follows the axes order of the geometry
